d:
Lime's 2nd Reze gallery.

Lime's notes:
"Following up from last time, I've drawn Reze from Chainsaw man again.

From a planning perspective, the devil costume was actually our top choice. I was very impressed with it when I read the original source material.

However, when depicting the one with firecrackers, I removed the apron. Even though they're flexible, it's difficult to completely hide the front with it.

I wanted to give off a slutty vibe, so the guy this time is a background character. The image I had in mind is a Reze who got rejected by Denji and was desperate for a rebound.

I was able to depict the kind of play I wanted to portray, so I'm personally satisfied."
